name: PTC India Financial Services Ltd
title: PTC India Financial Services Ltd - 533344 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Sanctions surged to INR3,448 crores (vs 825) but disbursements only INR1,235 crores, with about INR2,000 crores undisbursed and AUM shrinking on prepayments; Gross Stage III fell to INR190 crores, though management has repeatedly missed the funding and disbursement timelines it had guided.

triggers.label: Sanctions INR3,448 cr vs INR825 cr
triggers.quote: Sanctions stood at INR3,448 crores compared to INR825 crores in FY '25

triggers.label: Gross Stage III down 73% to INR190 cr
triggers.quote: Gross Stage III assets reducing by 73% to INR190 crores from INR711 crores

triggers.label: Disbursement guidance missed in Q4
triggers.quote: agreed that we had assured that we'll disburse INR1,500 crores almost in Q4

triggers.label: Quarterly yield fell to 10.29%
triggers.quote: the yield on the earning portfolio softened to 10.29% from 11.27%

guidance.quote: you'll see at least, say, 30% to 50% growth year-on-year

guidance.value: Budget under approval; INR4,000 crore target not set
guidance.quote: That target is yet to be s et. The budget is in the process of approval.

guidance.value: Not declared; to review next quarter
guidance.quote: we have not declared and we'll review it in the next quarter

prior_guidance_check.metric: Q4 FY26 disbursement of about INR1,500 crores
prior_guidance_check.quote: agreed that we had assured that we'll disburse INR1,500 crores almost in Q4
INR 4,000 crores was not committed last year. It was a different number.
we have not declared and we'll review it in the next quarter
By the end of this quarter, we will get the sanction and cash in the hands, sir?

red_flags.label: CEO/MD resignation after ~2 years
red_flags.quote: Mr. Balaji has resigned for some of his personal reasons

red_flags.label: Repeated funding and disbursement assurances not delivered
red_flags.quote: we had assured that we'll disburse INR1,500 crores almost in Q4

red_flags.label: Large Stage III exposure to one NCLT-referred promoter
red_flags.quote: The major portion of the GNPA is Danu Wind Parks

red_flags.label: Idle liquidity while lending is slow
red_flags.quote: we are still flushed with cash

evasions.quote: Balaji has given his reasons in his resignation letter. It is on a public domain.
Still, the treasury team is working on that.
we'll review it in the next quarter

evasions.topic: Resolution timeline for Danu Wind Parks
evasions.quote: As far as the time line for any resolution is there, the process is on.
